=== simple
start
if (Graphviz installed?) then (yes)
  :process all diagrams;
else (no)
  :process only sequence;
endif
stop
=== nested
start
if (a?) then (yes)
  if (b?) then (yes)
    :ab;
  else (no)
    :a not b;
  endif
else (no)
  if (c?) then
    :c;
  endif
endif
stop
=== elseif chain
start
if (condition A) then (yes)
  :Text 1;
elseif (condition B) then (yes)
  :Text 2;
  stop
elseif (condition C) then (yes)
  :Text 3;
elseif (condition D) then (yes)
  :Text 4;
else (nothing)
  :Text else;
endif
stop
=== elseif inlabels
start
if (A) then (yes)
  :one;
(no) elseif (B) then (yes)
  :two;
(maybe) elseif (C) then (yes)
  :three;
else (no)
  :four;
endif
:after;
=== vertical if
!pragma useVerticalIf on
start
if (condition A) then (yes)
  :Text 1;
elseif (condition B) then (yes)
  :Text 2;
  stop
(no) elseif (condition C) then (yes)
  :Text 3;
(no) elseif (condition D) then (yes)
  :Text 4;
else (nothing)
  :Text else;
endif
stop
=== vertical if two
!pragma useVerticalIf on
if (A) then
  :one;
elseif (B) then
  :two;
endif
=== condition inside
skinparam conditionStyle inside
start
if (test inside hexagon?) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== condition diamond
skinparam conditionStyle diamond
start
if (test above diamond?) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== condition InsideDiamond
skinparam conditionStyle InsideDiamond
start
if (test in diamond?) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== condition foo1
skinparam conditionStyle foo1
start
if (test foo1?) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== condition diamond down
skinparam conditionStyle diamond
if (x) then (yes)
  :only then;
endif
:next;
=== condition InsideDiamond down
skinparam conditionStyle InsideDiamond
if (x) then (yes)
  :only then;
endif
:next;
=== end hline
skinparam conditionEndStyle hline
start
if (test) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== end hline down
skinparam conditionEndStyle hline
start
if (test) then (yes)
  :a;
endif
stop
=== end hline break
skinparam conditionEndStyle hline
start
repeat
:x;
if (test) then (yes)
  :a;
  break
else (no)
  :b;
endif
repeat while (more)
stop
=== end hline then break
skinparam conditionEndStyle hline
while (w)
if (test) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  break
endif
endwhile
stop
=== end hline elseif
skinparam conditionEndStyle hline
if (a) then
  :one;
elseif (b) then
  :two;
else
  :three;
endif
=== swimlanes cross
|A|
start
if (c?) then (yes)
  |B|
  :in B;
else (no)
  |A|
  :in A;
endif
|A|
stop
=== swimlanes cross 2
|A|
start
:a;
|B|
if (c?) then (yes)
  :b1;
  |A|
  :a1;
else (no)
  :b2;
endif
stop
=== swimlanes down
|A|
start
if (c?) then (yes)
  |B|
  :in B;
endif
|A|
:back;
stop
=== swimlanes elseif
|A|
start
if (a) then
  :x;
elseif (b) then
  |B|
  :y;
else
  |C|
  :z;
endif
|A|
stop
=== swimlanes hline
skinparam conditionEndStyle hline
|A|
start
if (c?) then (yes)
  |B|
  :in B;
else (no)
  |A|
  :in A;
endif
stop
=== swimlanes down left lane
|A|
|B|
start
if (c?) then (yes)
  |A|
  :in A;
endif
|B|
stop
=== note right on if
start
if (c) then (yes)
  note right: a note on the test
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== note left on if
start
if (c) then (yes)
  note left: a note on the left
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== notes both on if
start
if (c) then (yes)
  note left: left note
  note right
    right note
    on two lines
  end note
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== note on if down
start
if (c) then (yes)
  note left: on down
  :a;
endif
stop
=== note on if down right
start
if (c) then (yes)
  note right: on down
  :a;
endif
stop
=== long labels
start
if (this is a very long test condition that is long) then (this is the yes label which is long)
  :a;
else (and this is the no label, quite long too)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== multiline test
start
if (first line\nsecond line\nthird) then (yes\nsure)
  :a;
else (no\nnever)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== url on if
start
[[http://plantuml.com]] if (linked?) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== url tooltip on if
start
[[http://plantuml.com{tip}]] if (linked?) then (yes)
  :a;
endif
stop
=== colored if
start
#pink:if (colored?) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== colored elseif
start
#pink:if (a?) then (yes)
  :a;
#palegreen:elseif (b?) then (yes)
  :b;
else (no)
  :c;
endif
stop
=== arrow colors in branches
start
if (c) then (yes)
  -[#red]->
  :a;
  -[#blue]->
else (no)
  -[#green,dashed]-> label;
  :b;
endif
-[#orange]->
:after;
=== arrow labels in branches
start
if (c) then (yes)
  -> into a;
  :a;
  -> out of a;
else (no)
  :b;
  -> out of b;
endif
:after;
=== then kill
start
if (c) then (yes)
  :a;
  kill
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== else detach
start
if (c) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
  detach
endif
stop
=== both stop
start
if (c) then (yes)
  :a;
  stop
else (no)
  :b;
  stop
endif
=== then stop else empty
start
if (c) then (yes)
  stop
endif
:after;
stop
=== then end
start
if (c) then (yes)
  end
else (no)
  :b;
endif
:after;
=== then spot
start
if (c) then (yes)
  (A)
else (no)
  :b;
endif
:after;
=== empty both
start
if (c) then (yes)
else (no)
endif
stop
=== empty then
start
if (c) then (yes)
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== goto in branch
start
label here
:a;
if (again?) then (yes)
  goto here
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== break in loop if
start
while (w?)
  if (c) then (yes)
    break
  endif
  :a;
endwhile
stop
=== endif colors
start
if (c) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif <<#pink>>
stop
=== stereotype if
start
if <<s>> (c) then (yes)
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
stop
=== if is equals
start
if (x) is (1) then
  :one;
elseif (x) equals (2) then
  :two;
else
  :other;
endif
stop
=== many elseif
start
if (1) then
:a;
elseif (2) then
:b;
elseif (3) then
:c;
elseif (4) then
:d;
elseif (5) then
:e;
elseif (6) then
:f;
endif
stop
=== elseif all stop
start
if (1) then
stop
elseif (2) then
stop
else
stop
endif
=== elseif else stop
start
if (1) then
:a;
elseif (2) then
:b;
else
stop
endif
:after;
=== elseif break
while (w)
if (1) then
break
elseif (2) then
:b;
endif
endwhile
=== nested deep
start
if (a) then
  if (b) then
    if (c) then
      :abc;
    else
      :ab;
    endif
  else
    :a;
  endif
endif
stop
=== handwritten
skinparam handwritten true
if (c) then
:a;
else
:b;
endif

  -> lbl;
  :a;
else (no)
  :b;
endif
=== diamond style colors
<style>
activityDiagram {
  diamond {
    BackgroundColor #palegreen
    LineColor #green
    FontColor red
    FontSize 14
  }
}
</style>
if (styled?) then (yes)
:a;
else (no)
:b;
endif
=== arrow style
<style>
activityDiagram {
  arrow {
    LineColor blue
    FontColor red
  }
}
</style>
if (styled?) then (yes)
:a;
else (no)
:b;
endif

if (**bold** and //italic// <color:red>red</color>) then (yes)
:a;
endif

start

if (q) then (y)
|L3|
:a;
|L2|
else (n)
|L1|
:b;
endif
|L2|
stop
